cards.title: Eval
cards.tagline: Check a command and its manifest fixture.
cards.label: Verified with Kujo
cards.alt: Verified with Kujo: Eval. Check a command and its manifest fixture.
cards.caption:
“It ran” is a weak handoff. This Eval example runs the canonical release smoke suite: a command succeeds, the manifest exists, and its size clears the check. The JSON results stay available for the next tool or reviewer.

https://github.com/kujolang/eval/blob/71e66dff780d6930bcbe093c046bf31aa26411df/examples/release_gate_suite.json
cards.notes: A successful command alone is not a complete release smoke check. Executed the unchanged canonical three-check release suite against its copied kennel.toml fixture. This checks a command, file existence, and file size; it does not evaluate model quality. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/eval/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.

cards.title: Workcell
cards.label: Verified with Kujo
cards.alt: Verified with Kujo: Workcell. Policy preflight. No container launched.
cards.caption:
Before running agent work, I want to see the boundaries. Workcell resolves this hello definition into a compact policy summary: network off, read-only root, explicit limits. This card verifies preflight; it does not claim a container ran.

https://github.com/kujolang/workcell/blob/189d7ab6e975301a0e5100b65e8ad3fe4a584573/examples/hello/workcell.json
cards.notes: Execution settings are hard to review when they are buried in launch commands. Executed validate and inspect --summary on the unchanged hello definition. No container was launched; Docker was unavailable. Network none and resource limits are resolved policy, not observed enforcement. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/workcell/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.

cards.title: PackWrite
cards.tagline: Offline pack checks. No model call.
cards.label: Verified with Kujo
cards.alt: Verified with Kujo: PackWrite. Offline pack checks. No model call.
cards.caption:
An agent handoff is only useful if the pieces are there. Here PackWrite validates an existing six-phase fixture and reports no missing files. This is the offline validation path, not a claim about a freshly generated plan.

https://github.com/kujolang/packwrite/blob/721dcc0ad41eaedc159d84f34a06396f92ede79f/README.md#commands
cards.notes: An incomplete agent pack can send the next session into guesswork. Executed validate and summary on the released golden-agent fixture with six phases. The fixture is a test input, not newly generated model output. No provider was called. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/packwrite/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.

cards.caption:
I do not want run history trapped in chat. This RunLedger example starts a local receipt, finishes it, writes a report, and checks the ledger. The verdict is supplied by the caller. Token usage and costs stay unset.

https://github.com/kujolang/runledger/blob/ab0ec5d2edb7ffd913f48d092aa6fc17cab58d13/README.md#quick-start
cards.notes: An agent session ends, and its run context disappears into chat history. Executed a scripted receipt lifecycle using provider local and model scripted-example. Pass is a supplied demonstration verdict. No token usage, costs, model invocation, or automated quality judgment is claimed. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/runledger/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.

cards.title: Lens
cards.tagline: Check desktop and mobile; keep evidence.
cards.label: Verified with Kujo
cards.alt: Verified with Kujo: Lens. Check desktop and mobile; keep evidence.
cards.caption:
“Looks fine here” is not much evidence. Lens checked this local dashboard at desktop and mobile sizes, applied the supported spec assertions, and saved screenshots plus reports. Useful handoff material without an LLM judging the page.

https://github.com/kujolang/lens/blob/85778065ca329c93293b387a0e7011437b6d0c60/examples/specs/dashboard.json
cards.notes: A page can look fine at one size and still have console or layout problems. Executed a local dashboard fixture with desktop/mobile screenshots, accessibility and link checks. Adapted the canonical spec by removing unsupported not_exists. No accessibility certification or production-site coverage is claimed. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/lens/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.

cards.title: ShipCheck
cards.label: Verified with Kujo
cards.alt: Verified with Kujo: ShipCheck. Gate on explicit release-readiness checks.
cards.caption:
Release prep should not depend on remembering every file. ShipCheck gates this pinned repo checkout on its readiness checks and returns JSON plus an exit code. It checks release signals; it does not run the project tests for you.

https://github.com/kujolang/shipcheck/blob/7eedd9e02d8730d65e06e16f4984d909d23539bc/README.md#gate-semantics
cards.notes: A release checklist is easy to forget when shipping gets busy. Executed gate --format json against the pinned ShipCheck release checkout. This checks repository readiness signals, not test execution, artifact integrity, or release certification. Output shown here, when present, was observed in evidence/verified/shipcheck/stdout.txt. Full commands and artifacts are in the verification report.
